description: An incorrectly flagged candidate for a plot formatting choice. This should NOT be promoted to a Judgment Point because the choice does not materially affect the analysis results or conclusions.

candidate.question: Should the temperature contour plot use a sequential or diverging color map?
candidate.reason: The color map affects how temperature gradients are visually perceived in the output plot.

alternatives.label: Sequential color map
alternatives.description: Use a single-hue sequential color map (e.g., viridis) for the temperature contour.
alternatives.tradeoffs: Good for showing magnitude progression. May make it harder to identify the exact boundary between high and low temperature regions.

alternatives.label: Diverging color map
alternatives.description: Use a diverging color map centered on the mean temperature.
alternatives.tradeoffs: Highlights deviation from the center value. May overemphasize regions near the center point.

candidate.uncertainty: None. Both color maps display the same underlying data.

dismissalReason: Plot formatting choices do not affect analysis results, conclusions, or validity. This is a presentation decision, not a consequential technical choice.
